facts.fact: Cabo Verde's data protection authority (CNPD), reporting on its member's role at an African AI governance workshop in Accra (29 September to 1 October 2025), recognises the need to give the country legislation to regulate AI, which it presents as not yet existing; the item is signed at Praia on 3 October 2025.

note: Reports the kick-off of an AI strategy; a strategy is class other and states no law, draft or rule on AI.
